headline: Intensional computation and agent-era databases reshape AI infrastructure discussion
body: A resurgence in theoretical computer science discussions around intensional computation and fast-branching database architectures is gaining traction across developer communities. For healthcare AI specifically, these foundational concepts matter because clinical decision support and real-time EHR integration depend on database performance at scale. As healthcare organizations evaluate AI agent architectures for autonomous workflows, understanding database branching efficiency becomes critical to meeting response time requirements in production environments. Self-hosted LLM infrastructure options are emerging as alternatives to cloud vendors, which directly impacts how health systems can deploy proprietary models while maintaining data governance and compliance.
